description: console.log / console.error / console.warn in committed code
fixGuidance: Remove before committing. Use structured logging or your observability tooling instead.
Use a reactive pattern, loader with streaming, or debounce with a derived.
Use Tailwind utility classes defined in app.css.
Remove the <style> block and express styles as Tailwind utility classes.
Use $app/state instead (Svelte 5 API).
Use $state runes for reactive state.
Check Lucide first. Extract to $lib/components/ otherwise.
Add return cleanup, or use $derived/onMount instead.
Use $derived for computed state. Only onMount with localStorage/sessionStorage/DOM refs.

description: $effect that only calls a single function
fixGuidance: Use onMount instead for single-function calls with no reactive dependencies.
Confirm $effect has a cleanup function and references a browser-only imperative API.
Use the typed openapi-fetch client from AppFactory in production code.
Define an I<ServiceName> TypeScript interface in the same file.
AppFactory uses static methods only and contains zero business logic.
hooks.server.ts sets only locals.user — no other locals, no route guards, no data fetching.
Use $derived(by => data.X) instead of $effect to sync data into $state.

description: $derived calls fetch or a service method
fixGuidance: $derived must be a pure computation — move async work to a loader.

Use <Accordion, Collapsible> from shadcn.

description: Arbitrary Tailwind value syntax (bg-[...], text-[...], etc.)
fixGuidance: Add the colour as a CSS custom property in app.css first, then reference it as a Tailwind token.
Use a lookup object of pre-approved token names instead: const colourMap = { primary: 'bg-primary' }.

description: Experimental modifier class on semantic HTML
fixGuidance: Modifier classes (.glass, .neumorphic) restricted to Hero components and Overlay widgets.

description: Service importing another service, store, or framework module
fixGuidance: Services never import other services or stores. Use a controller to orchestrate multiple services.
Controllers have no framework knowledge. Move @sveltejs/kit imports to the loader.
Stores hold reactive state only. Move service/controller calls to the loader.
Data comes from the loader via $props. Don't call services directly from the page.
Use the typed openapi-fetch client via AppFactory.
hooks.server.ts sets only locals.user. Move service calls to the loader.
createApiClient() must only be called in factories/.
Only factories assemble concrete implementations. Import the Protocol interface everywhere else.
AppFactory must only be imported in src/routes/. Import the service interface everywhere else.
Extract logical sections into components/domain/.
Consider extracting sections into components/domain/.
Extract business logic into a service. Controllers orchestrate — services do the work.

description: Loader or form action exceeds 20 LoC
fixGuidance: Move logic into a controller or service. Loaders parse input, call factory, return output.
Use loaders and form actions instead of raw API endpoints.

description: API route count exceeds 20% of page routes
fixGuidance: Prefer loaders and form actions over API routes.

description: Promise.all used directly in a loader
fixGuidance: Move Promise.all into a controller method. Single-service controllers are an anti-pattern — call service directly from loader via factory.

description: Raw HTTP status code outside error handler
fixGuidance: Use throw error(status, ...) for unrecoverable errors (renders +error.svelte) or return fail(status, ...) for recoverable form errors.

description: Fixed pixel width on page root
fixGuidance: Use responsive or fluid widths instead of fixed pixel values.
Add a responsive breakpoint variant (md:, lg:) to absolute positioning on layout elements.
Add a responsive breakpoint variant to whitespace-nowrap on layout elements.
Wrap the page content in <PageShell>, <Container>, or <AppLayout> as the direct root child.

description: No responsive breakpoint classes in .svelte file
fixGuidance: Add responsive breakpoint variants (sm:, md:, lg:) for layouts.

description: Test file outside tests/unit/, tests/integration/, or tests/e2e/
fixGuidance: Move into the correct directory.

description: Test name does not describe an invariant
fixGuidance: Name the test after the invariant it proves: test_cannot_X, test_returns_Y_when_Z.

description: More than one assert/expect in a test
fixGuidance: Split into separate test functions, one per assertion. Name each after the invariant it proves.
Write a fake that implements the full Protocol/interface. Put it in tests/fakes/.
Add a reason string explaining why this test is skipped and when it should be re-enabled.

description: npm or yarn lockfile found instead of pnpm
fixGuidance: Use pnpm exclusively for the frontend.
Keep frontend/.env and backend/.env separate. Never share secrets.
Add a test file under tests/unit/ covering its core invariants.
